title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go + v1.24.0 bumps
author: Lena Park
description:
Motivation: SDKs across Python, TypeScript and Go have diverged in auth configuration defaults, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This causes user confusion, harder cross-language support, and subtle production bugs when clients expect parity. This PR unifies behaviors and improves ergonomics while preserving backward compatibility where possible.

What this does (summary):
- Standardize auth layering: support token provider + env + explicit credential object in all three SDKs with consistent precedence and clearer error messages.
- Centralize retry policy: add a shared retry config surface (max_retries, initial_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, jitter) and align defaults to 5 retries, exponential backoff with full jitter, initial 100ms, max 5s.
- Streaming ergonomics: make streaming APIs expose an async iterator / readable stream abstraction in each SDK (Python: async generator with cancel(), TS: ReadableStream + convenience .onMessage callback, Go: channel-based iterator with Context cancel).
- Parity fixes: minor API name alignment (client.stream_messages -> client.chat.stream in TS/Go/Py), consistent error types and codes, and aligned docstrings/comments.
- Version bumps: Python v1.24.0, TypeScript v1.24.0, Go v1.24.0. Changelogs updated.

Compatibility notes:
- Defaults changed for retry parameters (see release notes) but old config keys are still accepted with a deprecation warning logged for one release cycle. No breaking changes to public method signatures aside from stream helper names (alias kept for one release).

Testing done:
- Unit tests added/updated across all three SDK repos for auth precedence and retry edge cases.
- Integration tests for streaming with mock server to validate cancellation and error propagation.
- Manual smoke with internal demo app.

Checklist:
- [x] Add unified auth layer implementation
- [x] Add retry config and implement in HTTP client wrappers
- [x] Add streaming ergonomics helpers for Py/TS/Go
- [x] Update docs and changelogs
- [x] Add/adjust tests

References: Linear ENG-5482 (SDK parity / retries), ENG-5499 (streaming ergonomics), related PRs: pr-142864-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.22.0, pr-143210-sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.23.0.

Notes for reviewers: focus on retry boundary conditions and language-native ergonomic surfaces. The auth precedence implementation is small but needs review for edge cases where both env and explicit providers are present.

Deprecated old retry config keys — see migration guide. Version bumps to v1.24.0 for Python/TypeScript/Go.
